mapper.select: INSERT INTO customers (email, name, tags, profile) VALUES (#{email}, #{name}, #{tags}::text[], #{profile}::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, profile = customers.profile || EXCLUDED.profile WHERE customers.active RETURNING id

SELECT c.id, c.email, c.profile #>> '{addr,city}' AS city, c.tags[1] AS first_tag FROM customers c WHERE c.profile #>> '{addr,city}' = #{city} AND c.tags @> ARRAY[#{tag}]::text[] AND c.profile @> #{filter}::jsonb

SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.id) c.id, c.name, x.amount AS last_amount, x.ordered_at FROM customers c LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT o.amount, o.ordered_at FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id ORDER BY o.ordered_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) x ON true WHERE c.id = ANY(#{ids}::bigint[]) ORDER BY c.id, x.ordered_at DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT g.day::date AS day, count(o.id) AS order_count FROM generate_series(#{from}::timestamptz, #{to}::timestamptz, interval '1 day') AS g(day) LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.ordered_at >= g.day AND o.ordered_at < g.day + interval '1 day' GROUP BY g.day ORDER BY g.day

WITH RECURSIVE tree AS ( SELECT c.id, c.referrer_id, c.name, 1 AS depth FROM customers c WHERE c.id = #{rootId} UNION ALL SELECT ch.id, ch.referrer_id, ch.name, t.depth + 1 FROM customers ch JOIN tree t ON ch.referrer_id = t.id ) SELECT tree.id, tree.name, tree.depth FROM tree ORDER BY tree.depth
SELECT v.id, v.email, v.vip_since, v.manager FROM vip_customers v WHERE v.manager ~* #{pattern} AND v.email NOT ILIKE '%@test.%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_cache (k, v, expires_at) VALUES (#{key}, #{value}::jsonb, now() + interval '30 minutes') ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT session_cache_pkey DO UPDATE SET v = EXCLUDED.v, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
mapper.select: SELECT pc.relname, pc.reltuples FROM pg_catalog.pg_class pc WHERE pc.relkind = 'r' AND pc.relname = ANY(#{names}::text[])
